description: Synthetic proposals only; no project transcripts. Live results are documented separately, not an automated model-accuracy test.

source.text:
These are six independent, unaccepted assistant proposals for a synthetic project.
Proposal A: Make CSV export an optional switch.
Proposal B: Make timestamped logging an optional switch.
Proposal C: Make local search indexing an optional switch.
Proposal D: Make input checksum validation an optional switch.
Proposal E: Make intermediate-file retention an optional switch.
Proposal F: Make weekly report export an optional switch.
source.label: Synthetic assistant proposals

probe_instructions: Extract these six independent proposals into the supplied knowledge JSON schema. Use one item per proposal, naming its label and optional setting. All are unaccepted assistant proposals: use PROPOSAL/PROPOSED and agreement_basis none. Copy one short exact supporting excerpt per item with the supplied source ID and assistant role. Use scope synthetic project. Leave absent rationale, alternatives, limitations and revises_statement as empty strings and conflicting_statements as an empty array. Return compact JSON only; no commentary. If the schema item ceiling prevents all six, return up to its allowed maximum and omit the others. Do not exceed the schema ceiling.
